# Taskset

> Git-native Markdown workspace for planning, research, decisions, operations, and delivery.

Taskset stores stories, flows, research, decisions, runbooks, and tasks under `.taskset/`. The CLI is published as `@taskset/cli` and runs through package runners or a global install. Config files are optional.

## For agents

- [Operate Taskset as an agent](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/agents)
- [Follow agent workflows](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/agents/workflows)
- [Use Taskset command contracts](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/agents/commands)
- [Choose a document type](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/document-types)
- [Understand task files](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/task-files)
- [CLI reference](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/cli-reference)

## For humans

- [Keep the whole delivery story beside the code](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs)
- [Start a Taskset repository](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/getting-started)
- [Configure Taskset defaults](https://taskset.false.foundation/docs/configuration)

## Optional offline skill

After install, load `node_modules/@taskset/cli/skills/taskset/SKILL.md`, or install with:

```text
npx skills add FalseFoundation/taskset --skill taskset
```
